glosses: To cause to stink; to fill with stench.

examples.text: The broccoli really stank out the refrigerator.

“Dere ya go. Bung it in ’ere, quick. Before it stinks de whole flat out.”
Zoe almost gasped at the unfairness of what the woman had just said. It was her fat stepmother’s prawn-cocktail-crisp breath that stank the place out! Her breath could strip paint. It could shear the feathers off a bird and make it bald.

glosses: To perform very badly in (a place).
To drive away from a place by a stink.

examples.text: They could build a fertilizer factory and stink you out.

glosses: Infecter de la peste ou de certaines maladies contagieuses.

examples.text: Des cadavres en décomposition avaient empesté l’air.
Les rats ont empesté toute cette région.
…au fond de sa poche, un œuf d’agace, pourri, cassé qui poissait la doublure et empestait.
L’air du dedans empeste le gas-oil brûlé et le vieux poisson.

glosses: Corrompre les esprits et les cœurs par de mauvaises doctrines.

examples.text: Les fausses idées dont on empeste une partie de la jeunesse.
